external_entities.name: colleague
external_entities.description: A staff colleague who signs in through the identity broker and uses applications.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Everything colleagues use signs them in through one identity broker.
external_entities.notes: The text says colleagues may sign in from their own devices at home; it does not place the colleague or device in a specific trust zone.

external_entities.name: franchise colleague
external_entities.description: A colleague from a franchise store whose own identity provider vouches for them.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Franchise colleagues do not have staff accounts with us
external_entities.notes: The text does not specify which franchise colleagues the external identity provider may vouch for.

external_entities.name: HR system
external_entities.description: The system that supplies colleague and group-membership changes to the identity broker overnight.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Group membership is not maintained there by hand — it comes from the HR system overnight.
external_entities.notes: The text does not state whether the HR system is operated by the organisation or by another party.

external_entities.name: identity provider
external_entities.description: A franchise identity provider that vouches for franchise colleagues to the identity broker.
external_entities.source_excerpt: their own identity provider vouches for them
external_entities.notes: The text does not identify which colleagues this provider is allowed to vouch for.

processes.name: identity broker
processes.description: Signs colleagues in, issues tokens, accepts franchise identity-provider sign-ins, supplies public signing keys, pulls HR changes, and writes sign-ins to an audit log.
processes.source_excerpt: Everything colleagues use signs them in through one identity broker.
processes.notes: The broker's directory contains colleagues and group membership; it also handles the signing key and audit logging.

processes.name: store admin console
processes.description: An application that uses the token's groups to authorize price changes and transaction voids across every store.
processes.source_excerpt: The store admin console is one of those applications.
processes.notes: The console does not check which store the colleague belongs to, so a store-manager token works against every store.

data_stores.name: key store
data_stores.description: A store holding the signing key used by the identity broker to sign tokens for every application.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The broker signs tokens with a signing key it keeps in a key store.
data_stores.notes: The text does not say whether the key store is encrypted where it sits.

data_stores.name: directory
data_stores.description: The identity broker's directory containing colleagues and the groups they are in.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The broker keeps the colleagues and the groups they are in its own directory.
data_stores.notes: Group membership is supplied by the HR system overnight. The text does not say whether the directory is encrypted where it sits.

data_stores.name: audit log
data_stores.description: A log to which the identity broker writes sign-ins.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The broker writes sign-ins to an audit log.
data_stores.notes: Nobody has written down what the log records or whether it covers the franchise route. Nobody has written down whether the log is encrypted where it sits.

data_flows.name: sign in
data_flows.description: A colleague signs in to the identity broker, which issues a token in response.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Colleagues sign in to it from wherever they are
data_flows.data_description: Sign-in information; the broker issues a token carrying the colleague's staff id and groups.

data_flows.name: change prices
data_flows.description: A colleague presents a token to the store admin console and uses the authorized functions to change prices or void transactions.
data_flows.source_excerpt: If the token has the store-manager group in it, the console lets the holder change prices and void transactions.
data_flows.data_description: A token carrying the colleague's staff id and groups, plus price changes and transaction voids.

data_flows.name: fetch public key
data_flows.description: The store admin console fetches the public half of the broker's signing key to check token signatures.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Applications fetch the public half from the broker to check the signature.
data_flows.data_description: The public half of the token-signing key.

data_flows.name: pull changes
data_flows.description: The identity broker pulls colleague and group-membership changes from the HR system once a night.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The broker pulls the changes once a night

data_flows.name: update membership
data_flows.description: The identity broker updates its directory with changes from the HR system.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Group membership ... comes from the HR system overnight.

data_flows.name: write sign-ins
data_flows.description: The identity broker writes sign-in events to the audit log.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The broker writes sign-ins to an audit log.
data_flows.notes: The text does not say what the log records or whether this flow covers the franchise route.
data_flows.data_description: Sign-in events; the recorded fields are unknown.

data_flows.name: vouch sign-in
data_flows.description: The franchise identity provider vouches for a franchise colleague and the identity broker accepts that as a sign-in.
data_flows.source_excerpt: their own identity provider vouches for them and the broker takes that as a sign-in
data_flows.notes: The text does not specify which colleagues the provider is allowed to vouch for.

trust_boundaries.name: corporate network
trust_boundaries.description: The corporate network on which the identity broker and store admin console run.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The broker runs on the corporate network.

trust_boundaries.name: home devices
trust_boundaries.description: The zone containing colleagues' own devices at home from which they may sign in.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: including their own devices at home
trust_boundaries.notes: The text names the devices as belonging to colleagues but does not identify a separately modelled device element.

trust_boundaries.name: franchise stores
trust_boundaries.description: The franchise-controlled zone associated with the franchise stores and their identity provider.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: We also let the franchise stores in.
trust_boundaries.notes: The text does not explicitly place the franchise identity provider or franchise colleagues in this zone.

assumptions.assumption: The identity broker holds confidential data because its directory contains colleague information and its key store contains a token-signing secret.
assumptions.basis: The description says the broker keeps colleagues and group membership in its directory and signs tokens with a signing key.

assumptions.assumption: The key store's contents are confidential because it holds the signing key used for every application's tokens.
assumptions.basis: The description states that the key store holds the broker's signing key.

assumptions.assumption: The directory's contents are confidential because it holds colleagues and their group memberships.
assumptions.basis: The description states that the directory keeps colleagues and the groups they are in.

assumptions.assumption: The store admin console holds financial information because it changes prices and voids transactions.
assumptions.basis: The description states that the console lets a store manager change prices and void transactions.

assumptions.assumption: The price-change interaction writes financial data at the store admin console because the console changes prices and voids transactions.
assumptions.basis: The description states that the console lets the token holder change prices and void transactions.
